About this item

  • LINED JOURNAL NOTEBOOK: RETTACY Lined Journal Notebook comes in a A5 size (5.7'' x 8.3''), 192 numbered pages, 7 mm college ruled, durable and smooth leather hardcover, 100 GSM thick acid-free paper, 180° lay-flat, pen holder, elastic closure band, 2 ribbon bookmarks, inner pocket & sticky notes
  • HIGH-QUALITY PAPER: Crafted with 100 GSM time-resistant paper, RETTACY journal resists ghosting and bleed-through for clean, crisp pages. Acid-free material ensures long-term preservation, while its smooth surface enhances writing clarity - durability meets performance
  • LEATHER HARDCOVER: RETTACY Journal Notebook's cover is made of smooth leather hardcover, offering protection for your precious entries. With this exquisite cover, you can rest assured that your journal will be a cherished keepsake for years to come
  • 180° LAY-FLAT DESIGN: The 180° lay-flat design ensures effortless writing and comfortable reading, allowing seamless use of both pages. It eliminates awkward angles and enhances the overall writing experience, adapting smoothly to any writing surface
  • VERSATILE APPLICATIONS: Perfect for daily journaling, goal setting, idea generation, planning, note-taking, memory keeping, its structured format ensures clarity and organization, making it an invaluable companion for anyone seeking to enhance their daily life

  8. About Us

    Born from a passion for documenting life, RETTACY is a stationery brand focused on thoughtful writing experiences.

    We craft notebooks and journals with eco-friendly materials, featuring smooth leather covers, smooth writing performance, and durable bindings. Our minimalist design lets you capture ideas and moments without distraction.

    We’re dedicated to creating reliable, purpose-built tools to accompany your everyday creativity and reflection.

  9. What makes our products unique?

    Smooth leather covers, eco-friendly bleed-resistant paper, strong bindings, and minimalist design set us apart for elegant, long-lasting daily use.

    Why do we love what we do?

    We’re passionate about turning ideas into lasting memories, building thoughtful stationery that supports creativity and everyday reflection.

    What is our vision?

    Our vision is to be the go-to stationery brand for capturing life’s ideas and moments, building reliable, elegant tools that support creativity and turn fleeting thoughts into lasting memories.

Product description

RETTACY Lined Journal Notebook with Leather Hardcover

RETTACY Lined Journal Notebook with Leather Hardcover

7mm College Ruled Spacing

Designed with precision and attention to detail, our 7mm college ruled pages offer a balanced layout that encourages clear, organized writing. Whether you're jotting down lecture notes, brainstorming ideas, or tracking your daily thoughts, the optimal spacing ensures readability and ease of use

100 GSM Acid-free Paper

100 GSM paper is thicker, sturdier. Whether you're jotting down your thoughts, ideas, or memories, our journal will ensure that your words are preserved in tip-top condition. You can confidently use most pens, pencils and markers without ghosting and bleed-through

Smooth Leather Hardcover

RETTACY Journal Notebook's cover is made of smooth, leather hardcover, offering sturdy protection for your precious entries. With this exquisite cover, you can rest assured that your journal will be a cherished keepsake for years to come

2 Ribbon Bookmarks

Imagine being able to mark two different pages or sections simultaneously, without the hassle of flipping back and forth. Our dual bookmark ribbons allow you to do just that, making it easier to keep track of important information or to compare different parts of your notes

Elastic Closure Band

The elastic band securely holds your notebook closed, keeping all your pages and contents safely in place. Whether you're on the go or settled in your workspace, you can rest assured that your notebook will remain firmly closed, preventing any unexpected flips or straying pages

Pen Holder

The pen holder securely holds your favorite pen, ensuring it's always within reach. No more fumbling around for a missing pen or worrying about it getting lost in your bag. With our notebook, your pen will always be right where you need it, ready to capture your thoughts and ideas

Content & Numbered Pages

With every page meticulously numbered, you can easily navigate through your notebook, quickly finding the information you need. Whether you're referencing a specific section for a project, or simply want to keep track of your progress, the numbered pages make it effortless

180° Lay-flat

RETTACY Lined Journal can be fully opened and each page can lay flat on a desk without closing or bending, making it easier to read or write notes without limitations or inconvenience

Inner Pocket & Sticky Notes

This handy pocket provides a secure and accessible space for all your small yet important items. Whether it's a receipt, a USB stick, a business card, or any other item you need to keep close at hand, the internal pocket keeps them organized and within reach

Colorful Colors

Embrace the rainbow of creativity with our vibrant collection of notebooks! Whether you prefer the serenity of blue, the warmth of orange, or the freshness of green, we have a hue to inspire every mood and thought

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
My must-have daily notebook
These are my favorite notebooks. I have repurchased and bought for others probably over a dozen times. They are relatively fountain pen friendly. Depends on the ink and nib size but I use a medium nib with Diamine Writers Blood and only have a tiny bit of bleed through if I write over another spot before it is dry (like correcting a letter or something). It does take a second to absorb so don’t flip your page immediately or your ink with smear. Light colored Tom Bows are ok and dark are fine if you don’t build up more than one layer. (Light is pic 3, minimal multi-colored pattern show through in pic 4) The two ribbon book marks are a game changer for me. Price is amazing for what you are getting. I consider these far superior to moleskin for half the price. Page count is great. I have been using the same one as a commonplace (so writing a blurb or two almost every day, give or take) since January ‘26 and am only a little more than halfway through. Lays flat and is still in like new condition even as I throw it in my bag, bring to the beach, etc. (last two photos) Great color selection that is true to the image provided. I can’t say enough good things. I will probably have at least one of these in rotation at all times.

I have been using the same one as a commonplace (so writing a blurb or two almost every day, give or take) since January ‘26 and am only a little more than halfway through. Lays flat and is still in like new condition even as I throw it in my bag, bring to the beach, etc. (last two photos)

    Great color selection that is true to the image provided.

    I can’t say enough good things. I will probably have at least one of these in rotation at all times.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Sturdy, beautiful, and perfect for heavy use.
    Reviewed in the United States on September 10, 2025
    Style: DottedColor: Dark Green

    I use two of these journals at a time: one to plan my novel, and the other as a diary/braindump combo. I don't decorate the pages or do any impressive bujo designs, so I can't speak to how it would serve as a bullet journal. However, these babies see a lot of heavy writing use from me. I've purchased four of them so far and not a single one has disappointed.

    Page thickness is great. I accidentally spilled water on a couple pages and it didn't bleed through, which was shocking to me, given how affordable this journal is compared to most others listed. The pages are smooth and easy to write on, so be careful with any pens that might smudge or smear. The paper will certainly make it easier to pick up and spread wet ink on your hands. I'm a ballpoint user and I've noticed that finer tips work best, but even with the standard cheap-o pens, I just give them a minute or two to dry and then I'm highlighting all over them with no problem.

    It's solidly built. I've never had any issue with pages falling out, or the bookmark ribbons unfurling - and I'm writing in my journal at least 3 or 4 hours a day, constantly flipping back and forth through multiple brain dumps. (If you've got ADHD, you understand what I mean.) The color of the cover and ribbons are absolutely stunning, somehow prettier than the pictures show imo. I personalize the covers of my journals with stickers and writing, and whatever I put on has lasted.

    Overall, this journal has consistently impressed me by serving me well and I couldn't recommend a better one.

    The paper in these RETTACY Notebooks is absolutely fantastic. Smooth to the touch, easy on the eyes, and takes fountain pens as well as ballpoint, rollerball, and pencil all like a dream. The ghosting/show-through through is really minimal, and bleed through almost nonexistent (a tiny bit with a really wet fountain pen). Also works nice with Ranger ink stamp - still no bleed through although there is ghosting/show-through. The lining/grid/dot grids is clear but very subtle and non-distracting. (Do note that the lined notebooks (as opposed to grid, dot grid, or blank) to come with "Date" printed in the upper corner of each page). I think these are easily the equal in quality of Midori MD, Clairefontaine clothbound and Premium C.D. - now, all those (and these) have their own minor aesthetic differences (the Midori paper is creamier and a bit toothier, the Clairefontaine and C.D. is much "slicker"; cover differences, etc.) so everyone will have their favorites - but you won't be disappointed on quality - and how can you beat the price!!!! A million times better than Moleskin

About this Item

  • LINED JOURNAL NOTEBOOK: RETTACY Lined Journal Notebook comes in a A5 size (5.7'' x 8.3''), 192 numbered pages, 7 mm college ruled, durable and smooth leather hardcover, 100 GSM thick acid-free paper, 180° lay-flat, pen holder, elastic closure band, 2 ribbon bookmarks, inner pocket & sticky notes
  • HIGH-QUALITY PAPER: Crafted with 100 GSM time-resistant paper, RETTACY journal resists ghosting and bleed-through for clean, crisp pages. Acid-free material ensures long-term preservation, while its smooth surface enhances writing clarity - durability meets performance
  • LEATHER HARDCOVER: RETTACY Journal Notebook's cover is made of smooth leather hardcover, offering protection for your precious entries. With this exquisite cover, you can rest assured that your journal will be a cherished keepsake for years to come
  • 180° LAY-FLAT DESIGN: The 180° lay-flat design ensures effortless writing and comfortable reading, allowing seamless use of both pages. It eliminates awkward angles and enhances the overall writing experience, adapting smoothly to any writing surface
  • VERSATILE APPLICATIONS: Perfect for daily journaling, goal setting, idea generation, planning, note-taking, memory keeping, its structured format ensures clarity and organization, making it an invaluable companion for anyone seeking to enhance their daily life
